verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly walk through creating a voice assistant, connecting a phone number, and making a first call in under 5 minutes (vapi-docs-18, vapi-docs-19), with voice selection via the Voice Library (vapi-docs-8, vapi-docs-24) and dashboard-driven assistant creation with templates (vapi-docs-16); community evidence corroborates a working live-call demo (vapi-comm-1). Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of the full 'within an hour' timing claim beyond vendor docs and a single anecdotal community comment.
